scope.invariant: Reject stale/disposed theme selections before host allocation and persist only a current live selection; distinguish a failed preference save from a real theme fallback.
exclusions: Real DOM focus/layout, browser module-fetch retry, runtime/host/mobile acceptance
Independent host module activation cancellation design and plugin/native authority
scope.interfaceChanges: No package dependency, public export, loader target, storage schema/key, props/emits, theme resource contract or host allocation callback signature changed. The composable failure flag is now derived from its error kind and remains a boolean ref for consumers.

baseline.headChangeAssessment: Other work advanced HEAD during this repair. Unrelated source/tests/docs and reports were preserved. The four repair inputs are recorded by final hash.

changes.detail: Return before starting work if already disposed; check generation/disposal immediately after the loader resolves and before invoking the side-effectful allocation callback. Retain post-allocation and post-activation checks. The workbench additionally ignores retained actions and late persistence after disposal or replacement.

Track theme/read/write failure kinds independently from the derived failure boolean. A failed write keeps the working theme and explicitly reports that preference saving failed. Retrying selection saves normalized per-theme settings and clears the error. Only a current usable default presentation reports a default fallback; failed default recovery uses a neutral error.

checks.detail: Implementation stays with the trusted controller and workbench preferences; owner tests stay in each package. No runtime/plugin-center implementation, public export or dependency was added.
Literal build-known loaders and canonical descriptor validation remain unchanged; rejected imports can retry.

Permanent tests cover superseded imports, imports finishing after disposal, actions after disposal, late allocation rejection, import retry, queued cleanup, mounted composable disposal and renderer recovery. Existing controlled presentation/state tests remain passing.

Theme preference shape/key and normalized density remain unchanged. Save failures report the actual persistence failure, retain the active theme and permit retry; real and failed default fallback report distinct outcomes.

13 permanent regressions were added. Before source fixes, five of the first 12 new scenarios failed, reproducing the reported defects and retained-after-disposal work. Final targeted and complete repository tests pass. Root formatting retains 12 untouched pre-existing documentation issues; scoped acceptance does not close those issues or the rest of B08.

target.note: Initial six theme scenarios plus seven existing module scenarios; the seventh theme scenario and final assertion changes were subsequently rerun separately.
Final owner file, including failed-default fallback and settled asynchronous outcome checks.

gates.note: Complete root script, including all package/application tests, Cargo workspace tests and 183 TS/Rust differential protocol cases. Concurrency is limited; assertions and test timeouts are unchanged.

gates.invocation: Executed by pnpm build:prod before recursive production builds.
gates.note: All shared/application checks and the Tauri Rust checks pass. An earlier standalone run encountered two syntax errors in another audit temporary file; that file was subsequently removed by its owner.

gates.reason: 12 pre-existing documentation files fail formatting. git diff from the repair starting HEAD shows none of those files changed. The four repair files and generated report/ledger formatting pass separately.

gates.note: Root production build, including Userscript artifact and Tauri release --no-bundle with --locked --no-default-features; no product UI was launched.

supersededFailures.reason: First root run overlapped typechecks and used default package/file concurrency. Existing application lazy-creation imports timed out at 20 seconds and a Userscript source polling assertion exceeded its 1-second wait. Full rerun with bounded concurrency passes without changing implementation/assertions/timeouts for those tests.
The first new test imported UiThemeSelection, which is not publicly exported. The test now infers the value from the public injection key; no product export was added.

Unrelated temporary B11 audit file used constructor parameter properties with erasableSyntaxOnly. The file disappeared before the successful final root build typecheck. This repair did not modify or remove it.

live.reason: The user requested repair and verification, without explicit browser/application inspection. No dev server, preview, browser, app, emulator or screenshot was launched.
